aa_determinism_gptoss._what: gpt-oss-120b: byte-identical WITHOUT-arm requests issued as SEPARATE calls (memory_repr is in the cache key). Identical content => the endpoint is deterministic at temperature 0 on the real context shape, WITHIN ONE SESSION.
aa_determinism_gptoss.\ud83d\udd34_SCOPE_WITHIN_SESSION_ONLY: Both calls in every pair come from ONE run. This licenses 're-issuing an identical request moments later in the same run returns identical text'. It does NOT license cross-session reproducibility: the same comparison across one day moved 554/1,124 on gpt-oss-120b (0/1,124 on gemma-4-31B-it). Quote this number only with its session scope. See docs/SESSION_DETERMINISM_AUDIT.md.
